name: rsvp-speed-reader
title: RSVP Speed Reader
description: Rapid Serial Visual Presentation: words flash one at a time at a fixed focal point with the optimal recognition letter (ORP) highlighted in red, play/pause and WPM control — reading 400 wpm without moving your eyes.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Medium
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Mechanical
Typography: Monospace
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Playback Control: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
